paragraphs.text: Jamira , sometimes called "Jammy" by her friends, is a female minotaur with druidic powers from Aranzhur . She is the daughter of the planeswalker Angrath . She was invited to join the first official multiplanar class of Strixhaven University on Arcavios . More than anything, she wants to understand the equations at the center of everything. She aspires to become a part of Quandrix , the college of mathematical magic.

Jamira is a former blacksmith from the now-destroyed plane of Aranzhur . She is the daughter of the planeswalker Angrath , and the sister of Rumi . Jamira is tall like a rhox , with broad shoulders and a muscular build. Her head is horned and bovine , and a thin line of coarse hair runs down the back of her neck. She usually has silver chains and charms dangling from her horns. On her plane, these indicate her relationship status, profession as master blacksmith, desired college, and other details about her. She is forthright and values being honest, even if telling the truth sometimes makes her come off as blunt. Steady and hard-working, she is a much-needed rock for her more chaotic friends. Her voice is feminine, soft, rich, and gently pitched.

As a geomancer, Jamira can bend soil and metal to her needs. She is able to create long grasping tendrils of stone and earth, glowing from within by an electric heat, for defense and attack. Her theory classes at Quandrix helped her to keep them flexible longer by encouraging the moisture in the soil to move according to its own needs rather than solidifying into clay.

Raised on Aranzhur, Jamira was traumatized by the sparking of her father, the death of her mother in his absence, and the destruction of her home plane by the New Phyrexian Invasion . She blamed the Blind Eternities and planeswalking for everything that had gone wrong in her life. Because of this, she was terrified to become a planeswalker herself.

Jamira was recruited for Strixhaven by Professor Kasmina because she had been identified as an ember , a potential Planeswalker , and a powerful wizard. On Arcavios, Jamira formed a class with the ambitious Eula Blue , Segante , Alandra , and Kequia Akosa . When Kasmina revealed that Jamira was an ember, she wanted nothing to do with it. Afraid, she begged the Professor to remove her spark if possible, and promised to do anything to accomplish that goal.

Meanwhile, she discovered that she was adept at Mage Tower and joined a team of mixed and undecided students. Her training schedule and frequent matches created a distance between her and her classmates, although she began to have feelings for Kequia. In a secret plot, Professor Kasmina also endeavored to create tensions between the classmates. She manipulated Jamira into work with the Arcavios Preservation Society and even abducting Orestes , pretending this helped her to prevent Jamira from Igniting .

In the end, it was revealed that Kasmina had selected the five students because they had the potential to be powerful planeswalkers. Her underlying purpose was to force them to ignite under stressful circumstances, and to rob their sparks to reignite her own. This plot was thwarted by the five students combining their powers, and Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl .

Afterward, Professor Vess had to task to to punish the five students for their various transgressions, with consideration of Kasmina's role. She allowed them to stay on and pledge to their individual colleges, but forbade them to relocate to the appropriate dorms. This also allowed them to serve as residential advisors to the next incoming class of cross-planar students.
